items.headline: Sensex soars 1,233 points to 75,692.78 and Nifty 1.68% to 23,440.80 as oil slides on Iran diplomacy
items.summary: Third straight gain; oil & gas and metal indices led while tech and media lagged. Nifty closed above its 50-day average. Builds on last week's recovery.
items.rationale: Falling crude and peace hopes cut India's biggest macro risk, lifting rate-sensitive and oil-consuming sectors and drawing foreign buyers back.

items.headline: Brent plunges 7.63% to $104.77, its biggest drop in months, as Iran opens the door to talks
items.summary: WTI fell 7.36% to $96.46. Down from a six-month high of $117.64 on Friday. Reversing October's surge; strike risk after the 3 November US vote remains.
items.rationale: A $13 drop in three sessions sharply cuts India's import bill, fuel-subsidy risk and inflation pressure, easing the rupee and bond yields.

items.headline: Iran's supreme leader authorises the government to pursue peace talks with the US
items.summary: The US president says a deal 'could happen' and oil is 'dropping like a rock'. Iran still demands seven conditions and says Hormuz stays shut until the blockade ends. Biggest diplomatic step in weeks.
items.rationale: A path to reopening Hormuz would be the largest relief for India's oil, LNG and freight costs; conditions keep the outcome uncertain.

items.headline: 10-year G-Sec yield falls nearly 10 basis points to about 7.32% as crude slides
items.summary: Down 17 bps from the 7.48% four-year high on 26 October; short covering added. Traders see 7.25% if oil keeps falling. Extending last week's easing.
items.rationale: Lower yields cut borrowing costs, lift bank bond portfolios and ease the government's financing burden.

items.headline: Rupee slips 10 paise to 94.86 per dollar on a firm greenback despite the oil slide
items.summary: It touched 95.04 intraday. Traders see stabilisation after October's sharp gains. Pause, not reversal.
items.rationale: Cheaper oil should support the rupee in coming days; a firm dollar is limiting gains for now.

items.headline: Foreign investors buy a net ₹3,115 crore; domestic funds sell ₹392 crore (provisional)
items.summary: Second big buying day after ₹3,599 crore on Friday, following October's ₹52,100 crore outflow. Foreign funds still hold net short index futures. Reversing.
items.rationale: Returning foreign money supports large caps and the rupee; it depends on oil staying lower.

items.headline: Major fire after a reported explosion at a state refinery in Visakhapatnam
items.summary: Flames and thick smoke near an oil tank; cause of the explosion is under scrutiny. New.
items.rationale: An outage at a coastal refinery could tighten local fuel supply and dent the refiner's output, though national impact depends on duration.

items.headline: US conducts 'defensive strikes' on Iranian targets in Hormuz; Indian sailor killed off Oman
items.summary: Thirteen crew were rescued. A new wave of attacks hit tankers and an LNG carrier. Escalation on the water even as talks advance.
items.rationale: Continued attacks keep freight, insurance and crew risks high for Indian shipping and threaten the oil relief from diplomacy.

items.headline: India sources 70% of its crude imports from outside Hormuz, petroleum ministry says
items.summary: Diversification follows record imports of 5.6 million barrels a day. Ongoing shift away from Gulf routes.
items.rationale: Less reliance on Hormuz reduces supply-shock risk for Indian refiners, though longer routes raise freight costs.
